content: EdgeOne Edge Functions runtime (pages.edgeone.ai/document/edge-functions, official docs): context object has request/params/env/waitUntil. Supports Web Crypto API fully (crypto.subtle with all standard algorithms per edgeone.ai/document/52693), Cookies API (edgeone.ai/document/52685) for get/set/append/remove with httponly/secure/samesite support, Fetch, Headers, standard Web APIs. Env vars accessed via context.env.KEY. CPU time limit 200ms, code package 5MB, request body 1MB, ES2023+ only. No addEventListener support (unlike older Cloudflare Workers style).
